verdict.rationale: Content was quoted verbatim from multiple gov.uk guidance pages (trade mark registration, patent application, trade mark search, topic and organisation pages), which indicates the public reading surface is fetchable as plain HTML. The probe explicitly notes that the gov.uk guidance pages remain the open surface. The robots.txt wall it observed is on the separate trademarks.ipo.gov.uk search application, not on the guidance pages. Missing for 10: a direct probe of the gov.uk guidance pages recording HTTP status and confirming no bot wall, JS-only shell or CAPTCHA under an identified UA; independent corroboration of agent access.
